name: Pagination Off-By-One Bug
prompt: page.js exports paginate(items, page, size): page is 1-based (page 1 is the first `size` items). Users report page 1 skips the first items and the last page is sometimes missing. Fix the bug. It must return { items, page, totalPages }, totalPages is at least 1, and a page past the end returns an empty items array. Keep the name and export. Run it, then commit.
